build_LEO_meta_learning_model: build a LEO meta-learning model with latent embedding optimization for few-shot classification
run_LEO_inner_loop: run the LEO inner loop that adapts classifier weights via latent space gradient updates
run_finetuning_inner_loop: run the finetuning inner loop that adapts classifier weights on training data then evaluates on validation data
compute_LEO_gradients: compute gradients of the LEO meta-training loss with NaN-safe fallback to regularization
build_LEO_encoder_decoder: build the LEO encoder and decoder pipeline that maps inputs to latents and then to classifier weight distributions
